svg.text: Study 1 data, re-read by the v1.3 instrument
Descriptive only. v1.3 verdicts are not comparable with Study 1's registered ones; this is a reading aid, not a contrast.
STUDY 1 DATA, READ BY THE v1.3 DEV INSTRUMENT (descriptive)
E1: blocking findings per file, by spec level × model (65 accepted cells)
Every cell: 0 blocking findings, so 100% of findings are advisory (74–89% of them FF-CV05
test-file pairing). The Study 1 spec-level difference lives entirely in the advisory tier.
SO4: same doc §2 table; results/v1.3-study1-rerun/so4/{score.json, by_operator.csv}. The MO-X01 gain is the dynamicImports option; the SO4 bases were known while v1.3 was built.
